title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Ensure timely completion of all statutory requirements, such as PF, ESIC, and other relevant filings.
 Provide guidance on company policies and procedures to ensure adherence across departments.
 Manage HR operations, including employee life cycle management, payroll processing, and compliance with labour laws.

Key Skills: Labour Laws,Statutory,Compliance,Law,Labour,Resource
